label: 1-2 steps after an x in the original sequence (mid positions)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the one or two steps right after the letter x was input, mostly at positions 3-6. Activation is strongest on the step directly after x (prev_tok=x: rate 0.30, lift 16.7x, 75% of mass), weaker two steps after, and fades within about 3 steps. Top activations come when x is at position 2-3, often doubled (x x), with the peak on the token after the second x. Very weak at t<=2 and t>=7, and silent in the copy phase. It sometimes fires a little at <DEL> when x came just before. Leftover misses are mostly tiny activations (<0.1 of max) in sequences with no x. Some steps after x stay silent, especially when x is late (t=7) or at position 1.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: x, e, l, c, 1, n; least: p, j, k, b) and the input two steps back (most: x, l, t, d, s, e; least: b, k, j, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=5, t=4, t=6.
